name: presidio-pii
description: Local reversible PII redaction for DeepSeek Harness: unified bundle dsh-presidio-pii handles runtime redaction, safe FS tools, and settings UI. entity_types and config below remain live.
_deprecated_hooks_notice: DSH 0.2.x does not mount Python hooks. See plugins/dsh-presidio-pii/ for the active unified bundle. entity_types/config below remain live.

on_before_llm.description: Redact PII in the outgoing prompt; stores mappings under a per-conversation session_id.

on_after_llm.description: Restore ⟦PII:TYPE:SEQ⟧ placeholders in the LLM response back to original PII.
